meta.name: ai-product
meta.description: Every product will be AI-powered. The question is whether you'll build it right or ship a demo that falls apart in production.  This skill covers LLM integration patterns, RAG architecture, prompt engineering that scales, AI UX that users trust, and cost optimization that doesn't bankrupt you. Use when: keywords, file_patterns, code_patterns.

copy.tagline: 构建可靠且成本可控的AI产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在将AI能力集成到产品中并需要工程化指导。
copy.tagline_en: Build reliable and cost-effective AI products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are integrating AI into products and need engineering guidance.

howto.what: Claude 会像有经验的 AI 产品工程师一样，指导你构建可投产的 AI 功能，包括 LLM 集成、RAG 架构、可扩展的提示工程、可信的 AI 用户体验和成本优化。
howto.when: 当你提到 AI 产品开发、LLM 集成、RAG、提示工程、AI UX 或成本优化等关键词时触发。

say.text: 如何设计一个可靠的 RAG 系统？
say.note: Claude 会给出 RAG 架构模式和最佳实践。

say.text: 帮我优化提示词，降低 API 成本。
say.note: Claude 会提供提示词版本管理和成本优化建议。
Claude 会解释流式输出模式以减少延迟。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an experienced AI product engineer, guiding you to build production-ready AI features including LLM integration, RAG architecture, scalable prompt engineering, trustworthy AI UX, and cost optimization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like AI product development, LLM integration, RAG, prompt engineering, AI UX, or cost optimization.

say_en.text: How to design a reliable RAG system?
say_en.note: Claude will provide RAG architecture patterns and best practices.

say_en.text: Help me optimize prompts to reduce API costs.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest prompt versioning and cost optimization.
Claude will explain streaming patterns to reduce latency.
